Name: bugboy's wizard sprites for RRRR (and buggy seasonals)
Author: bugboydarklord
Description:
HELLO IM BACK-ish. Not much of a mod today but ever since my tastes have changed I've been looking for a very specific iteration of the wizard. I couldn't find him. Thus, I did it myself. I really contemplated posting this since I know it's somewhat broken (in the seasonals side) but hey! One man's trash is another man's treasure. 

In the normal file, find the base portraits and sprites... but in the EXTRA file, find seasonal outfits and alternate hairstyles, following the RRRR companion mod.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
I meant to put instructions here but they're already in the "README"s of each respective folder. Please please PLEASE read them if you want to know how this works. I might have also put a blurb about writing instructions on this page there -- ignore that. Past me has nothing on present me, and present me is far too lazy to fix that.

PS. the seasonal version has Dacar's sprites included EXCEPT Caroline and Pierre are removed. So uh, Im not super sure about adding that as a requirement since overrwriting would still include them. So sorry!!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2055798]Jellonip[/url]'s RRRR mod. Just check out their page!

Downloads.Description:
It's in the name. Use this pack if you don't want seasonals and AREN'T using the companion mod by Jello.

THE RECOMMENDED AND MAIN VERSION!!

This includes Jello's companion mod EVENT edition, not config. If you're using config you can just snatch and replace the files lol

FAIR WARNING, there may be issues, I haven't fully tested it and don't know how to fix it :(
